tags.TITLE: Desperate Invasion
tags.LYRICS:
[Verse 1]
You always had the worst intention
Oh God damn, I'm so suspicious of you
Making a move
Sometimes when I go to bed
I see that we are all friends again
And I don't understand

[Chorus]
You dropped the marbles
Now you're gonna catch them
To see yourself is all that's left
The mirrors right there, check, check, check
Maybe, just maybe, you'll finally get it
You're gonna regret it
You're gonna regret it

[Verse 2]
Fuck you and all your friends
Why am I your main topic of conversation?
A desperate invasion
I'm just sticking up for myself
I know that's alarming when women do that
But we're people too

[Chorus]
You dropped the marbles
Now you're gonna catch them
To see yourself is all that's left
The mirrors right there, check, check, check
Maybe, just maybe, you'll finally get it
You're gonna regret it
You're gonna regret it


[Outro]
They're all so afraid of girls when they're in the right
Their power is threatened so they try and take their rights
Dismiss them, Dismiss them, they won't take it no more
The girls are not crazy they're just being treated poor
